mapper.select: SELECT PRJ_APLCNT_NO , RESUME_NO , USER_ID , APLCNT_STATUS_CODE , APLCNT_DATE , RCRT_PSNCNT_NO , PRJ_ANNC_NO FROM PRJ_APLCNT

SELECT AP.PRJ_APLCNT_NO , AP.RESUME_NO , AP.USER_ID , AP.APLCNT_STATUS_CODE , AP.APLCNT_DATE , AP.RCRT_PSNCNT_NO , AP.PRJ_ANNC_NO
, RC.RCRT_PSNCNT_NO , RC.PRJ_ANNC_NO , RC.JOB_CODE , RC.RCRT_PSNCNT
, AN.PRJ_ANNC_NO , AN.USER_ID , AN.PRJ_EMP_TITLE , AN.PRJ_TOPIC , AN.ANNC_CREATE_DATE , AN.PRJ_START_PLAN_DATE , AN.PRJ_END_PLAN_DATE , AN.PRJ_ANNC_HIT , AN.PRJ_ANNC_CONTENT , AN.ANNC_END_PLAN_DATE , AN.ANNC_END_YN
, TAG.TAG_NAME
FROM PRJ_APLCNT AP LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_RCRT_PSNCNT RC ON AP.RCRT_PSNCNT_NO = RC.RCRT_PSNCNT_NO AND AP.PRJ_ANNC_NO = RC.PRJ_ANNC_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_ANNC_BBS AN ON RC.PRJ_ANNC_NO = AN.PRJ_ANNC_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_ANNC_BOARD_TAG TA ON TA.PRJ_ANNC_NO = AN.PRJ_ANNC_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN TAG ON TA.TAG_NO = TAG.TAG_NO WHERE AP.USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT PRJ_APLCNT_NO , RESUME_NO , USER_ID , APLCNT_STATUS_CODE , APLCNT_DATE , RCRT_PSNCNT_NO , PRJ_ANNC_NO FROM PRJ_APLCNT WHERE PRJ_APLCNT_NO = #{prjAplcntNo}

SELECT PA.PRJ_APLCNT_NO , PA.RESUME_NO , PA.USER_ID , PA.APLCNT_STATUS_CODE , PA.APLCNT_DATE , PA.RCRT_PSNCNT_NO , PA.PRJ_ANNC_NO
, (SELECT JOB_NAME FROM JOB WHERE JOB_CODE = ( SELECT JOB_CODE FROM PRJ_RCRT_PSNCNT WHERE PRJ_ANNC_NO = PA.PRJ_ANNC_NO AND RCRT_PSNCNT_NO = PA.RCRT_PSNCNT_NO)) AS USER_POSITION FROM PRJ_APLCNT PA WHERE PA.PRJ_ANNC_NO = #{prjAnncNo}
